当你的应用需要实现VoIP音视频通话功能时（如即时通讯应用、企业办公应用），可以使用Call Service Kit的来电场景接口，将来电信息上报系统并展示来电横幅通知，用户无需进入应用即可接听或拒接
当你需要在应用内发起通话时，可以使用去电场景接口，系统会在屏幕左上角展示通话胶囊，提供通话状态显示和控制能力
如果你的企业应用需要在来去电页面展示企业联系人信息，可以接入企业联系人信息显示能力
接入 VoIP 来电并上报系统显示原生来电界面 / Integrate VoIP incoming calls and report them to the system to show the native incoming call UI
实现应用退到后台后仍能弹出来电横幅 / Show an incoming call banner even when the app is in the background
在系统通话页面展示主叫姓名、头像和企业信息 / Display caller name, avatar, and enterprise info on the system call screen
添加锁屏来电提醒并支持滑动接听或拒接 / Add lock-screen incoming call alerts with swipe to answer or decline
实现去电场景的系统通话界面和通话胶囊 / Implement the system calling UI and call capsule for outgoing calls
管理音视频通话的接听、拒接、挂断和通话状态同步 / Manage answer, reject, hang up, and call state sync for audio/video calls
上报多路通话状态并处理等待中来电切换 / Report multiple call states and handle call waiting switches
为即时通讯应用接入系统级来电通知体验 / Add a system-level incoming call notification experience for an IM app
在应用外展示可一键接听的 VoIP 呼叫通知 / Show VoIP call notifications outside the app with one-tap answer
配合推送消息拉起来电服务并展示来电页 / Wake up the call service with push messages and present the incoming call page
实现企业通信场景的专属来电展示和联系人标识 / Implement branded incoming call presentation and contact identity for enterprise communications
将自定义通话状态同步到系统通话管理 / Sync custom call states into the system call management
do_not_use_when: 需求是对条形码、二维码进行扫描、识别或生成，并处理暗光、模糊、曲面码等复杂识读场景；应改用 scan-kit / The requirement is to scan, recognize, or generate barcodes and QR codes, including difficult cases like low light, blur, or curved codes; use scan-kit instead
preconditions: 应用运行在标准系统真机上，且设备类型受支持（Phone、Tablet、Wearable），不支持模拟器 / The app runs on a real device with standard system and a supported form factor (Phone, Tablet, Wearable); emulators are not supported
已完成Call Service Kit开发准备并在module.json5中声明所需权限与能力 / Call Service Kit setup is completed and required permissions/capabilities are declared in module.json5
若需要后台来电拉起，已开通并正确集成Push Kit / If background incoming-call wake-up is needed, Push Kit is enabled and correctly integrated
应用具备可用的网络连接以接收或发起VoIP音视频通话信令 / The app has working network connectivity to receive or initiate VoIP audio/video call signaling
inputs: 来电或去电的通话信息 / incoming or outgoing call information
通话类型与状态参数（音频/视频、静音、接听、拒接、挂断等） / call type and state parameters (audio/video, mute, answer, reject, hang up, etc.)
联系人或企业联系人展示信息 / contact or enterprise contact display information
用于拉起或关联通话流程的应用上下文 / application context used to start or associate the call flow
outputs: 来电横幅通知（展示头像、名称/号码、音视频类型及接听/拒接等操作） / Incoming-call banner notification showing avatar, name/number, audio/video type, and answer/decline actions
锁屏来电通知 / Lock-screen incoming-call notification
多路来电通知条目 / Multiple incoming-call notification entries
去电通话胶囊（屏幕左上角显示通话状态/时长） / Outgoing-call capsule showing call status/duration at the top-left of the screen
去电实况窗通知 / Outgoing-call live activity/window notification
通话操作事件回调（接听、拒接、静音/解除静音、挂断） / Call action event callbacks for answer, decline, mute/unmute, and hang up
企业联系人来去电显示信息 / Enterprise contact information displayed on incoming/outgoing call pages

postconditions.statement: 工程中已接入Call Service Kit相关调用，用于上报来电或去电并管理通话交互 / The project includes Call Service Kit integration to report incoming or outgoing calls and manage call interactions
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set add or modify HarmonyOS code/configuration that integrates Call Service Kit APIs for incoming or outgoing call reporting and interaction management?

postconditions.statement: 已实现至少一种系统通话呈现能力：来电横幅/锁屏通知/多路来电管理/去电通话胶囊之一 / At least one system call presentation capability is implemented: incoming-call banner, lock-screen notification, multi-call management, or outgoing call capsule
postconditions.judge_prompt: By inspecting the edits, is at least one Call Service Kit UI presentation flow implemented or wired up, such as incoming-call banner, lock-screen call notification, multi-call handling, or outgoing call capsule?

postconditions.statement: 通话控制动作已与应用逻辑关联，可处理接听、拒接、静音或挂断中的至少一项 / Call control actions are connected to app logic and handle at least one of answer, reject, mute, or hang up
postconditions.judge_prompt: Do the edits connect one or more call control actions (answer, reject, mute, hang up) from Call Service Kit to application handling logic?
